messages:
Sam R: Hey team — quick handoff for next week's launch + webinar. Need a compact visual kit: benchmark hero, 6 snapshot tiles, and a one-slide timeline diagram. Low-effort, high polish. Deadline: Tue EOD for draft.

Ben D: Got it. Does this tie to the benchmark narrative we finalized yesterday?

Sam R: Yes — stick to the new comparison frame (latency vs cost tradeoff). Use the 3-point hook: predictability, cost, fallbacks. Keep copy very short.

Priya K: Can we include a CTA tile for the webinar registration and one for the benchmark readout? Need UTM-friendly short links.

Sam R: Yep — two CTA variants: webinar (primary) + benchmark (secondary). Priya will drop the final links by Monday AM.

Alice M: Quick Q on brand: are we allowed to use the orange accent on benchmark charts? Last brand sweep said accent is restricted to enterprise comms.

Sam R: @Alice M — use charcoal + teal for charts; reserve orange for hero callouts only. That's the compliance call from legal.

kate.design: Copying specs into Figma and starting artboard setup now. Will do a tight grid so tiles are reusable for ads/social. Sharing file in a sec. :thumbsup:

kate.design: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/0a1b2c/launch-sprint-kit — I created pages: HERO / TILES / TIMELINE / EXPORTS.

Ben D: Nice. For tiles: two hierarchy levels — primary metric (latency) big, secondary (cost) small. Colorbars only for delta, no stacked bars.

Sam R: Also add a tiny footer for model & infra note: "Redwood Inference — results may vary by model size." Keep it very small.

Alice M: Re: exports — need PNGs + editable Figma + a PDF slide. Also an animated GIF of the hero for social (subtle reveal).

kate.design: Noted. Quick export spec below, will follow these exactly: 

```
hero: 1200x628 @2x png, 600x314 @1x png
tile: 600x600 @2x png, 300x300 @1x png
timeline slide: 1920x1080 pdf + 1920x1080 png
gif (hero): 1200x628, 3 frames max, 1.5s loop
figma: editable file + flattened PNGs in a zip
```

Priya K: Can you include a variant of each tile with and without the CTA? We need both for organic vs paid.

kate.design: Yep — making two export groups per tile (CTA / no-CTA). Will annotate naming as TILE_name_variant.png.

Ben D: One more ask — include a small infographic-style microdiagram explaining routing: "Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private" with icons, for the timeline slide. Keep it abstract.

kate.design: Will draft a simple 3-step icon row. Any icon preferences?

Sam R: Use the rounded server rack, cloud, and lock icons from our brand pack.

Alice M: I'll do a quick brand compliance pass on the Figma file Monday morning. If anything, I'll flag color uses or type scale.

Sam R: Timeline: please map marketing milestones (teaser email, webinar, benchmark release) onto the slide — approximate dates only. Priya will list the exact times.

kate.design: Drafts by Mon 4pm PT for internal review, final exports Tue 5pm PT. Sound good? :sparkles:

Priya K: Yep — I'll post the registration link and the benchmark permalink Monday AM and the marketing cadence in the doc.

Ben D: Thanks — I'll review visual clarity and make a prioritization list for what must ship in the hero vs what can be deferred.

Sam R: Perfect. If anything blocks, ping me. Thanks everyone. :soon:
